preconditions.description: Number of vertices is between 1 and 200,000.
Number of edges is between n-1 and 200,000.
Number of clones is between 1 and the number of vertices.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= n for xi, yi in edges)
preconditions.description: All vertex indices in edges are between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= yi <= n for xi, yi in edges)
preconditions.description: All vertex indices in edges are between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines equals the number of clones.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(line.split()) <= 1 + max_vertices_per_clone for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each line has between 1 and max_vertices_per_clone + 1 elements.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(vertex) <= n for line in output_lines for vertex in line.split()[1:])
postconditions.description: All vertex indices in the output are between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: all(int(line.split()[0]) == len(line.split()[1:]) for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: The first element of each line matches the number of vertices visited by the clone.

postconditions.expression: all(any(int(vertex) == start_vertex for start_vertex in start_vertices) for line in output_lines for vertex in line.split()[1:])
postconditions.description: Each clone visits its starting vertex at least once.

postconditions.expression: all(any(int(vertex) in line.split()[1:] for line in output_lines) for vertex in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: Each vertex is visited by at least one clone.
